text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: We're in the middle of a meeting, but Mejiro McQueen seems to be zoning out. Feeling concerned, I bring it up…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: …What? Oh. My apologies. I was in a bit of a stupor. Perhaps I'm tired from my last race.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: I need to focus. A Mejiro must carry herself with dignity at all times.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Please excuse my rudeness. I'm fine now. Um… With that, well…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: My guess is she's still feeling tired. I should probably reevaluate her race schedule to ensure she can perform at her best going forward.
